Digital Foundry is now fully independent! Join the DF Supporter Program and support the team: https://bit.ly/3jEGjvx

The first of the series to purely target PS5 and Xbox Series consoles, Modern Warfare 4 makes the most of the generational leap with benefits to its COD Engine tech. Today the focus is on the PS5 Pro upgrades - specifically giving us improved effects, reflections and shading - with ruminations on its PSSR upscaler. Later, Xbox Series S gets its time in the spotlight, with testing across both its 120Hz and 60Hz modes.
